solutions.title: Carry from the end
solutions.description:
**Approach:** From the last digit: if `< 9`, increment and return; else set `0` and continue; if all nines, prepend `1`.

**Why preferred:** Standard carry pattern shared with add-binary / big-integer themes.

**Example walkthrough:** From the right of `[1,2,3]`, `3 < 9`, so bump to `4` and stop → `[1,2,4]`. For `[9,9]`, both become `0` and you prepend `1`.

solutions.title: Right-to-left carry
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Same carry walk; `unshift(1)` when the leading digit overflows.

**vs recommended:** Effectively the same solution — keep it. Optional polish: build a new array or `digits = [1, ...digits]` only on full overflow to avoid mid-array `unshift` cost.

**Example walkthrough:** Same right-to-left carry: increment or set `0` and continue; `unshift(1)` if you overflow the leading digit.
